name: verbaloop
description: VerbaLoop — Real-Time Multilingual Conversation Platform. Different languages. One conversation.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "shared,server,client" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "npm --workspace=shared run dev" "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=server run build && npm --workspace=client run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=server run test && npm --workspace=client run test
